_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#13 and dune::adaptive_poisson#0, #2, #3, #4, #5 — six claims about the same four grid/view objects, so one fixture; wall time 75 s (2026-08-06, dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured: the ALUGrid factories are camelCase (aluConformGrid/aluCubeGrid/aluSimplexGrid present, alusimplexGrid/alucubeGrid/aluconformGrid absent). structuredGrid has NO .mark attribute, while adaptiveLeafGridView(yasp) and yasp.hierarchicalGrid both DO — so its presence proves nothing. hasattr(space,'update') is False. globalRefine(1, uh) on a YaspGrid left (cells, space.size, dofs) at (16, 25, 25) -> (16, 25, 25): a silent no-op, no exception, no warning; on adaptiveLeafGridView(aluConformGrid) the same call went (32, 25, 25) -> (64, 41, 41). globalRefine(1, hierarchicalGrid) took 16 -> 64 cells. dune.fem.mark(..., gridView=...) and markNeighbors(..., gridView=...) both raise AttributeError "'GridMarker' object has no attribute 'gridView'". dune.fem.mark returns a NON-callable tuple, (-1, -1) without statistics=True, and passing it to adapt raises AssertionError 'only one list of discrete functions can be passed into the adaptation method'. adapt([uh]) on a plain ALUGrid leaf view raises AssertionError 'the grid views for all discrete functions need to support adaptivity'. The control is the documented cycle: mark then adapt took 64 -> 100 cells and 41 -> 63 dofs with the space resized and the function prolonged. ONE EXTRA MEASUREMENT, recorded because it cost a debugging round: the hierarchical refine gets its OWN grid object here, because calling globalRefine(level, uh) first REGISTERS a discrete function on a non-adaptive space, and a later hierarchical refine of that same grid then dies with RuntimeError 'NotImplemented [numBlocks:...indexsetdofmapper.hh:228]: Method numBlocks() called on non-adaptive block mapper'. On a fresh grid, with or without a space, it refines fine. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 runs the poisson#13 globalRefine(level, uh) probe on adaptiveLeafGridView(aluConformGrid), the view where that call is not a no-op. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'yasp_globalRefine_is_a_silent_noop=True', 'dune_refinement_and_adaptivity_api_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
